_comment: Single source of truth for the plan artifact contract.
scripts/plan_lint.py READS this file directly (no generated Python to drift), and
scripts/gen_plan_contract.py renders the prose section of policy/WORKFLOW_PROTOCOL.md
from it. Before this file existed there were three disagreeing contracts: the prose
The linter demanded two headings the prose never mentioned (Risks and Rollback,
Handoff Snapshot) and rejected the Unicode box-drawing every agent actually writes,
so compliant-looking plans failed and nobody noticed because the lint was absent
from the three repos holding ~50% of all plans. See ROM-4491.
_v2_note: Contract v2 (2026-11-05): Linear is retired fleet-wide (operator decision). Plans declaring 'Plan-Contract-Version: 2' use step_columns, which has no tracker column; a 'Linear Issue' column is rejected via retired_columns. Plans declaring version 1, or no version, are grandfathered under v1_legacy and lint exactly as before.

retired_columns.name: Linear Issue
retired_columns.message: Linear retired 2026-11-05 (contract v2): drop the Linear Issue column

diagram._allow_box_drawing_note: Agents write box-drawing unanimously. The old pure-ASCII rule rejected every real plan for no benefit; the requirement is a readable diagram, not code page 7.

_evidence_note: Evidence does NOT have to be a path. Command output, a regression observation or a validator verdict are all legitimate evidence, and requiring a path rejected 100+ real historical entries. What is rejected is a placeholder that asserts nothing.
_versioning_note: Rules added in a contract version apply only to plans that declare 'Plan-Contract-Version: N'. Plans without the marker are linted under the legacy ruleset. This is deliberate: grandfathering on a mutable 'Status: Completed' line let a plan escape the contract by editing one word.
_gating_note: since_version 0 = always required (the original prose contract). since_version 1 = added with the versioned contract and required only of plans declaring 'Plan-Contract-Version: 1'. Without this split, turning the lint on in the repos that hold ~50% of all plans produced 2,425 findings against plans written correctly against the prose they were given, and would have blocked every commit in those repos.

v1_legacy._note: Grandfathered rules for plans declaring Plan-Contract-Version: 1 or no version. These plans were written while Linear was the program board; they keep the tracker column and its ROM-123 id check so historical plans lint exactly as before. Nothing here applies to v2 plans.
v1_legacy._issue_reuse_note: Default is one Linear issue per program (Execution Mode: phased-program). The executable-step table may repeat that issue id on every row. Per-step issues are optional when a human needs a separate board row. overnight-single-issue remains the sequential overnight jinyang/Cyrus dispatch case.
